🚨🇺🇸 BREAKING: TRUMP ISSUES A STUNNING THREAT TO JOIN FORCES WITH PUTIN AND LAUNCH MILITARY STRIKES AGAINST UKRAINE IF ZELENSKYY REFUSES TO COMPLY WITH THE CEASEFIRE AGREEMENT!

In an escalation of the Russia-Ukraine conflict, US President Donald Trump has reportedly issued a direct ultimatum to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, warning that Washington could abandon Kyiv, align itself with Moscow and consider military action against Ukraine if Zelenskyy refuses to accept the proposed ceasefire agreement.

Trump expressed growing frustration with Zelenskyy’s position, warning that the United States would no longer tolerate what he considers deliberate resistance to efforts to end the war. He reportedly made it clear that continued American support should not be mistaken for an unconditional commitment.

“President Zelenskyy, let me make one thing absolutely clear: America has reached its limit. We have invested billions of dollars, committed enormous resources and spent considerable time trying to bring this conflict to an end. I will not allow the United States to continue carrying this burden while Ukraine refuses to accept the opportunity for peace.

I have spoken with President Putin, and I am prepared to take whatever diplomatic steps are necessary to secure an agreement. But if Zelenskyy believes he can defy Washington, reject our conditions and still expect unlimited American protection, he is making a serious mistake.

If Ukraine refuses to comply with the ceasefire agreement, I am prepared to completely change America’s position. We could withdraw our support, strengthen our relationship with Moscow and consider options that were previously off the table, including direct military action against Ukraine.

Let me be clear: I am not making an empty threat. There will be consequences, and they will be far greater than anything Zelenskyy appears to anticipate. I will not hesitate to make decisions that put America’s interests first, regardless of how uncomfortable those decisions may be for Kyiv.

Ukraine has a choice: accept the path towards peace or face the consequences of refusing to cooperate. The United States will not be held hostage by another country’s decisions. My patience is running out, and Zelenskyy should understand that this may be his final opportunity to avoid a complete breakdown in relations with Washington.”

The ultimatum would represent an extraordinary shift in Washington’s position and could fundamentally change the diplomatic and military dynamics of the conflict.

🇺🇸🇮🇱 The CIA and Treasury both got hacked within hours... and the new cyber chief now faces questions over a decade on an Israeli firm's board

FinCEN, the Treasury bureau that tracks money laundering, pulled systems offline Tuesday, right after the CIA admitted hackers reached unclassified data.

Acting cyber director Kirsten Davies spent about 10 years on the board of Team8, a firm founded by a former head of Israel's Unit 8200, her disclosures show, according to the outlet ¡DoNotPanic!. 

She left last December.

Ana Kasparian of The Young Turks says she can't tie any of it to the hacks, and she'd say the same about Canada or Italy:

"I do not believe that our government agencies should be contracting with any foreign cybersecurity company."

Davies faces a Democratic Senate for confirmation, and that hearing is hopefully where those questions get answered under oath.

@AnaKasparian
